Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: VM cadence + attestation for SIG/SOC2 pack

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the quick sync this morning. Finity's audit team is finalizing the SIG/SOC2 evidence bundle and has asked us to get an explicit statement of Redwood's vulnerability management cadence and a recent index of scan results. Two specific asks:

1) A short description of your authenticated and unauthenticated scan cadence (weekly/bi-weekly/monthly) and the SLA for remedial actions on Critical and High CVEs.
2) A recent scan index CSV (timestamps & scan tool/version) and any remediation logs for high/critical CVEs in the past 60 days — especially the entry for CVE-2027-0291 we discussed.

Can you provide an attestation email we can include in the packet and the files above by EOD tomorrow? If any of this needs a redacted extract instead of full artifacts, let us know acceptable redaction rules.

Appreciate it,
Elena
Elena Morales
Senior Information Security Manager | Finity Bank

security_ops@finitybank.com

Subject: Re: Request: VM cadence + attestation for SIG/SOC2 pack

Hi Elena,

Thanks — we can do that. Quick summary below and I attached the index + remediation log for CVE-2027-0291. We will also drop a one-page attestation you can include in the SIG/SOC2 bundle.

Summary (for inclusion in auditor packet):
- Authenticated scans: weekly (credentials rotated monthly).
- Unauthenticated external scans: bi-weekly.
- Container/static dependency scans (SCA): nightly for pipelines; monthly full SCA sweep on images in registries.
- SLA: Critical CVEs — initial triage within 24 hours and targeted remediation/mitigation within 7 calendar days; High CVEs — initial triage within 72 hours and mitigation within 30 calendar days. Exceptions are documented and approved by Security and Product.

What I'm attaching now:
- scan-index-May2027.csv (index of scans with timestamps and tool versions)
- cve-2027-0291-remediation-log.pdf (redacted remediation timeline and closure evidence)

We'll provide a short signed attestation PDF by EOD tomorrow and an internal one-page VM playbook summary for context. If you need further redaction (IPs, internal hostnames), please confirm exactly which fields to mask — we typically provide hostname hashes + asset tags for auditors.

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Security Operations | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0182

Naomi — quick internal note before we send the attestation.

Laura / Marcus: please confirm the following for the attestation packet:
- Can we expose full scanner tool output for third-party auditors, or should we provide the index CSV + per-CVE remediation PDFs as redacted extracts?
- For CVE-2027-0291 remediation log I redacted internal hostnames and replaced them with asset tags and kept timestamps and PR/CL links. Is that sufficient?

Also, Marcus — the 7-day remediation for Criticals in your runbook: do we want to tie that to the SLA language exactly as Naomi described or add the clause about may extend for scheduled maintenance windows with Security approval?

Thanks — want to keep Finity's auditors from asking follow-ups.

-Monica
